combination.note: the cheapest per-decision picks fail the reliability gate; the planner upgrades the least-cost stage(s) to meet it under the compatibility constraint

gate_ordering.policy: descending p_fail/cost (fail-fast per unit cost) - provably optimal for independent gates

honesty_notes: gate ordering is provably optimal for independent gates (adjacent-exchange on p_fail/cost)
combination search is exact branch-and-bound over the product space (small here)
success/failure probabilities come from receipts; cost from the declared cost model; nothing hand-typed
the engineer declares only paths + cost + win; the planner derives ordering/selection/combination
